findings.source: Phone: Вы, наверное, не в курсе, но он уже просил других извиняться за себя.
findings.currentTarget: Phone: Labda hujui, lakini tayari amewataka watu wengine kuniombea msamaha kwa niaba yake.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Phone: Labda hujui, lakini tayari amewataka watu wengine kuniomba msamaha kwa niaba yake.
findings.objectiveReason: The husband asks others to apologize to the wife on his behalf. Kuniombea asks forgiveness for the wife/speaker, reversing the beneficiary; kuniomba addresses the plea to her.
